profile_headline: Founder of Growthetics Growth Marketing Agency | On a Quest to Influence a Million Businesses by 2020
post_content:
The first remote employee I hired quit on me on the first day. I tried to
reason- But he'd made up his mind. He said he didn't want to work for a
startup. That day, I made a decision- Never hire remotely ever again. Months
passed. We hit a great milestone for our first content marketing client- 5 MN
hits. Landed more clients. I had to hire to handle the workload. So I started
hiring VAs part-time. That's when I met Asha online. For three months, she
toiled. Delivered all work on time. Stuck to deadlines. One random day, I
asked one of my growth hackers: "Who's the best prospector on the team?" He
didn't even have to think: "Asha". I rang her up that day. She mentioned that
the work we gave her was her only source of income. I felt embarrassed. I was
paying her pennies. She couldn't come work for us inhouse- She had a family
back home. The next day, I offered her a full-time remote position- Something
I'd sworn I'd never do. It's been 6 months now. Asha is a growth hacking
analyst at Growthetics today. She doubles as our HR manager. And she's moving
cities to join us inhouse tomorrow. As a founder, it's easier to not take
risks. To not trust anyone. But when you do, You stop being an employer. They
stop being employees. You become one family.

post_content:
Startups are similar to Chinese Bamboo tree The hashtag#Chinese Bamboo tree
takes 5 years to grow. They have to water and hashtag#fertilize the ground
where it is every day, and it doesn't break through the ground until the fifth
year. But once it breaks through the ground, within 5 weeks it grows 90 feet
tall. Now the question is, does it grow 90 feet tall in 5 weeks or 5 years?
The answer is obvious. It grows 90 feet tall in 5 years. Because at any time,
had that person stopped watering and hashtag#nurturing and fertilizing it,
that bamboo tree would've died in the ground. Same is applicable to our
hashtag#startups, we have to water it, nurture it, fertilize it for it to grow
tall. It will take time. If someone calls you mad when they will see you
tirelessly working on your startups without results. That is the time when you
have to keep your head down and believe in your dream that one day it will
grow tall. hashtag#Takeaways : It all starts with a solid root system It takes
small hashtag#actions every day It takes hashtag#persistence,
hashtag#patience, and hashtag#faith hashtag#entrepreneurship
